verdict.rationale: An HRIS/payroll stakeholder sync is a fair question for a cap table and equity management product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a Gusto, Rippling, or other HRIS integration, or automated syncing of new hires and terminations. Stakeholder data enters only through manual entry, bulk spreadsheet upload, or managed migrations from Carta and Pulley, and the only integrations shown are an MCP connector for AI assistants and registered-agent notifications.
